A close freezes original features/proofs, result, context and post-lookup local availability time; failed publication retains this exact close rather than refetching a later price. An atomic/fsync-before-replace nonfinancial outbox admits the snapshot before native Parquet/journal publication, then retains a completed archive. New observation identity/checksum fields are separate from all financial trade/return/proof fields. Native schema-cast Parquet dedup confirms an identical retry without another row or write count; conflicts fail. Research events retain original close time and deduplicate exact observations under OS ownership; portfolio updates are atomic and preserve newer opening identity in memory and on disk across restart. Actual False/error feature failure now neither increments appended_shadow nor discards the shadow; confirmed managed closures increment once, including a drained cancellation followed by original acknowledgement.28 new cases include six native partial-publication fault windows, a real new-process replay, concurrent publishers, nullable results, frozen retries, receipt-time causality, opening-IO interlock and owner/cancellation behavior. Current focused/full-CI results are separately recorded below. This does not certify complete nonblocking scanner IO, open/partial crash recovery, provider market-asof/execution or profitable full strategy. Original sizing/risk/model activation contracts remain unchanged and all operational processes remain off.
